messages:
mika: Hi all — quick Q. I need to travel to Lisbon 9/2-9/5 for a customer workshop. Corporate card cant be used for this vendor, so i'll have to put hotel on my personal card. Can i get an advance to cover the hotel and a per-diem?

maria - People Ops: hey @mika :wave: yes — you can request a travel advance to cover lodging + up to 50% of estimated per-diem. Submit the Travel Advance form and include an itemized estimate (flight, hotel, meals). Manager approval is required before People Ops signs off.

mika: thanks — do i need to keep meal receipts if i'm taking per-diem? Also what about rides to/from airport?

maria - People Ops: per-diem replaces meal receipts up to the daily cap, so no meal receipts needed for amounts covered by per-diem. Keep receipts for airport taxis/ride-hail and any reimbursable parking. For public transit (metro, tram) we don't require receipts if you're using per-diem, but keep them if you're claiming actuals instead.

jordan (Finance): FYI, when booking on a personal card: 1) tag the expense with the correct Cost Center, 2) upload the card statement line with the folio/receipt, and 3) note the advance amount so Finance can net it out. Missing receipt policy: items under $75 can use a signed missing-receipt memo; over $75 requires vendor follow-up.

mika: how fast are advances? my flight charge posts next week and i don't want to be out of pocket for too long.

maria - People Ops: standard is 3 business days after approvals. If you need funds sooner, select "Expedite" on the form and cc your manager — we'll escalate to Finance.

finance-bot: Automated: Travel advance requests without manager approval will be blocked. Add manager approval to proceed.

elaine: fwiw i did this for Madrid last month. Requested 50% for lodging and got it in 2 business days after manager sign-off. Finance reimbursed the rest in ~7-10 business days after I uploaded receipts to Ramp. Tip: upload all receipts in a single PDF and include the advance amount in the notes.

mika: perfect, i'll submit the Travel Advance form now and tag @maria if anything else pops up. thanks! :thumbsup:
